verdict.rationale: a-Shell documents its own first-party WASI-sdk. Developers can cross-compile programs against it on a computer and run the resulting WebAssembly in a-Shell, alongside on-device clang targeting WASI. However, the evidence is a single thin mention: there are no SDK docs, no language client libraries for driving a-Shell programmatically, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI. missing for 10: SDK reference documentation, official client SDKs for programmatic or agent control of a-Shell, versioning/support details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can also cross-compile programs on your main computer using our specific WASI-sdk, and transfer the WebAssembly file to your iPad or iPhone.
clang/clang++ compiles your C/C++ files to webAssembly with wasi included.
